result.summary: The layout is largely consistent, but there is a spelling error in the search field placeholder and an inconsistently styled favorite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card, which also has poor contrast.

issues.description: The search field placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the second Popular card (pizza) uses a dark/semi-transparent circular background with a white outline icon, while the identical button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card uses a white circle with a dark icon. The dark variant has weak contrast against the dark food photo.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite-button style across all cards (e.g., white circular background with a dark or brand-colored heart) to keep visuals uniform and ensure sufficient contrast over imagery.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card's image has a light gray background while the neighboring cards use dark photographic backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card imagery treatment (same background/overlay) so all carousel thumbnails share the same visual weight.
